Subject: Vendr onboarding: CAIQ mapping & presign window for SOC2 evidence

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for making time last week. Were ready to claim the Vendr profile and fast-follow with CAIQ/SIG evidence for our upcoming vendor assessment. A few asks from our side so we can align timelines:

- We need a short-runbook for presign upload windows (where Novum uploads evidence to your S3 presign or claims through Vendr).
- Wed like a CAIQ -> SOC 2 field mapping so our Compliance lead can tag artifacts appropriately.
- Temporary credentials: we prefer ephemeral STS credentials for a 2-4 hour window. Can Redwood provide guidance on role names/least-privilege permissions?
- Target timeline: get the profile claimed and initial evidence bundle in Vendr by next Wednesday (2026-09-02).

Can you confirm owner for the presign orchestration and whether you require DocuSign for the evidence custody attestation?

Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding: CAIQ mapping & presign window for SOC2 evidence

Hi Anikathanks for the clear asks. TL;DR: we can support an S3-presign workflow + short-lived STS access and weve attached a short runbook and a CAIQ->SOC2 mapping spreadsheet to speed this along. Proposed plan below.

Plan (high level)
1) Claim Vendr profile today (marcus).
2) We provide presign bucket + manifest template. Novum uploads artifacts during a coordinated 3-hour window (we recommend 09:00-12:00 PT).
3) Novum tags CAIQ fields in the attached mapping workbook; well run a quick ingest QC.
4) Naomi will validate any syslog/KMS proofs that require proof-of-possession.
5) Optional DocuSign attestation: we only require it if your legal team needs the signature for custody; otherwise an email attestation is acceptable for onboarding.

Action items for this thread
- Marcus: claim Vendr profile, send presign S3 details + manifest template. (ETA: 2 hrs)
- Camila: will coordinate the manifest & sample ingest once uploads complete. (ETA: onboarding window)
- Naomi: confirm the minimal KMS/syslog evidence types we can accept for SOC2 mapping (ETA: EOD).
- Novum: confirm upload window and whether DocuSign is required.

Attachments: vendr-onboarding-runbook-v1.pdf; caiaq-to-soc2-field-map.xlsx

Notes on permissions:
- We recommend a single IAM role with write-only access to a presign staging prefix for the agreed window, and CloudWatch PutObject/PutObjectAcl disabled. If you prefer STS, were happy to issue a pre-scoped session token with duration 2-4 hours.

Let me know if we should route this via Legal for signatures.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Security Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
[attachment: vendr-onboarding-runbook-v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding: CAIQ mapping & presign window for SOC2 evidence

Quick note from Compliance side:

- For KMS proofs: we can accept a signed KMS key policy export and a recent CloudTrail Put* event capturing envelope operations. If your environment uses a managed KMS, a signed KMS rotation statement + public key thumbprint works.
- For TLS certchains: we only need the cert chain PEM and the issuance time; no private material.
- If Novums uploads include large binary logs, please flag them in the manifest so Camilas ingest job can allocate time for checksum verification.

Also tagging convention: in the mapping workbook the required column is "redwood_field" (lowercase) so our ingest normalizer can pick it up.

If these pieces look ok Anika, well proceed with the 09:00-12:00 PT window Marcus suggested. Ill be available during the push for validation.

-Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Compliance Engineer, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
